note: Real ICY metadata blocks, as captured off live mounts. The iHeart/Triton
shapes are the ones that printed a wall of amgArtistId / TAID / TPID /
cartcutId on the panel: the scheduling record arrives *inside* StreamTitle,
sometimes with the inner quotes escaped and sometimes not, because the
encoder concatenates the url field without re-quoting it.
`expect` is null where the block carries no programme information at all.

The unterminated shapes are the fallback path: with no terminator the closing quote can only be the block's last character, never the last apostrophe in it -- StreamTitle='Rockin' Chair used to truncate to Rockin.
